Payment Terms: i. Payment shall be released only after the successful completion of the event and satisfactory execution of all contracted services, including stage setup, videography, supply of customized gifts and hoodies, and ot her deliverables specified in the tender. Payment shall be processed upon submission of the invoice and c ertification of satisfactory performance by the designated Institute authority. No advance or part payment shall be admissible. ii. Penalty for Delay and Deficiency in Services: The bidder shall ensure timely completion of all arrangements and deliverables strictly in accordance with the schedule prescribed by the Institute. In the event of delay, incomplete arrangements, defective or subs tandard supplies, non-performance, or failure to meet the approved specifications, the Institute shall be en titled to impose a penalty of up to 10% of the total contract value, depending on the nature and severi ty of the default. In case of major deficiencies, failure to provide essential services, or non-fulfilment of con tractual obligations affecting the successful conduct of the event, the Institute may, in addition to imposin g the applicable penalty, get the work completed through an alternative arrangement at the risk and cost of the bidder, as permissible under the contract, and take other appropriate action under the applicable te nder conditions. iii. Customized Gifts and Hoodies – Sample Approval: The bidder shall submit samples, designs, artwork, branding, colour schemes, material specifications, sizes , and other relevant details of customized gifts and hoodies to the Institute's Organising Team for prior ap proval before undertaking bulk production or supply. Production and supply shall commence only after writ ten approval of the samples and designs by the Organising Team. Any items supplied without approval or f ound inconsistent with the approved samples and specifications shall be rejected and replaced by the bidd er at no additional cost to the Institute within the timeline specified by the Institute. iv. Stage Setup, Videography and Other Event Arrangements: The bidder shall execute the stage setup, videography, supply of customized items, and all other contracte d services strictly in accordance with the specifications, approved designs, technical requirements, schedu le, and instructions issued by the Institute. All arrangements shall be completed within the stipulated timel ines and shall be subject to inspection and acceptance by the Institute's designated officials. v. Strict Adherence to Tender Conditions: The bidder shall strictly adhere to the scope of work, technical specifications, quantities, quality standards, approved samples, designs, and timelines specified in the tender. No deviation, substitution, alteratio n, or compromise in quality or specifications shall be permitted without prior written approval of the Institute. Any deviation made without such approval shall be treated as a contractual deficiency, and the Institute shall have the right to reject the affected work or supplies and require rectification or repl acement at no additional cost, without prejudice to other contractual remedies. vi. Comprehensive Turnkey Responsibility: The entire work shall be executed on a turnkey basis, with the bidder being solely responsible for coordi nation, procurement, production, transportation, installation, execution, dismantling, and delivery of all ser vices and items covered under the contract, as applicable. The quoted rates shall be deemed inclusive of a ll costs, labour, materials, equipment, transportation, installation, taxes, and other incidental expenses ne cessary for the satisfactory completion of the assigned work, except where expressly provided otherwise i n the tender. No additional payment shall be admissible for activities or incidental expenses required to ful fil the approved scope of work. 4 ATC must be signed by bidder .
